summary: P0 Owner-reported 'can't sign up' bug end-to-end verification. Walked the exact Owner flow via Playwright against the preview URL: anon shell shows Sign in + Create account (data-testids present) → click Create account → /auth/register → submit valid email+pw → land back at / signed-in with email + 'Viewer' role label + Sign out button. issues: Retired vocabulary 'RMS Intelligence' leaked in h1 title of AuthLoginPage.js (line 45-47) and AuthRegisterPage.js (line 41-43). The systemic vocab gate explicitly prohibits this term. Recommend replacing with Canon-safe wordmark such as 'Akki OS' (used by AkkiShell on all other Canon surfaces) or 'Canon OS'.

Every other Canon surface uses AkkiShell (title='Akki OS' or 'Canon OS'); the two auth pages diverge and are the only place this retired term still lives.
